chains.chain_name: Semiconductor EDA, IP, and Design Services
chains.description: Design-enablement chain for electronic design automation tools, reusable IP, verification, and specialized chip design services.
chains.scope: Covers EDA software, processor and interface IP, physical design, verification, tape-out support, and outsourced semiconductor design services.
exclusions: Fabricated wafers and foundry process capacity remain owned by wafer_manufacturing_specialty_processes.

chains.description: Compute-system chain for processors and accelerators that execute AI training, inference, graphics, and high-performance workloads.
chains.scope: Covers CPUs, GPUs, AI accelerators, NPUs, compute chiplets, and their package-level system interfaces.
exclusions: Memory products remain owned by memory_chips_storage_control, while data-center facilities remain owned by cloud_data_center_infrastructure.

chains.description: Memory-value-chain coverage for volatile and nonvolatile memory devices, storage media, and controllers that manage data persistence.
chains.scope: Covers DRAM, NAND flash, emerging memory, solid-state storage, memory modules, and storage controller manufacturing routes.
exclusions: General-purpose processors and AI accelerators remain owned by ai_logic_compute_chips.

chains.description: Signal-chain coverage for analog, mixed-signal, and radio-frequency integrated circuits that sense, condition, convert, and transmit signals.
chains.scope: Covers data converters, amplifiers, interface ICs, RF transceivers, timing chips, and mixed-signal subsystems.
exclusions: MEMS sensors are owned by mems_intelligent_sensors, and power switching devices are owned by power_semiconductors.
aliases: 模拟、混合信号与射频芯片

chains.description: Canonical industry chain for discrete and integrated semiconductor devices that switch, convert, and control electrical power.
chains.scope: Covers silicon MOSFETs, silicon-carbide power devices, gallium-nitride power devices, and their device-level manufacturing routes for power conversion applications.
exclusions: Power-supply equipment, converter assemblies, and application-specific power architectures remain owned by power_electronics_power_supply_equipment.
Signal-processing, radio-frequency, memory, and logic semiconductors remain owned by their respective semiconductor chains.

chains.description: Sensor-industry chain for MEMS devices and intelligent sensing components that convert physical phenomena into usable electronic data.
chains.scope: Covers MEMS inertial, pressure, acoustic, environmental, optical, and integrated intelligent sensor devices and their fabrication.
exclusions: Industrial inspection systems remain owned by industrial_inspection_metrology_machine_vision.

chains.description: Foundry-manufacturing chain for wafer fabrication, specialty semiconductor processes, and production services that turn designs into die.
chains.scope: Covers logic, memory, analog, compound-semiconductor, and specialty process wafer manufacturing and foundry operations.
exclusions: Fab process tools remain owned by semiconductor_manufacturing_equipment and input materials by semiconductor_materials_electronic_chemicals.

chains.description: Equipment and factory systems used to execute, control, and support front-end semiconductor wafer manufacturing.
chains.scope: Covers wafer-fabrication process equipment, inspection and metrology, wafer automation, vacuum and process delivery, and fab utility systems.
exclusions: Semiconductor materials are owned by the semiconductor materials chain.
Semiconductor packaging and test equipment are owned by the packaging and test chain, except wafer_thinning is temporarily canonical here and may be referenced by advanced packaging.

chains.description: Materials chain for wafers, gases, photoresists, chemicals, targets, and consumables used throughout semiconductor fabrication.
chains.scope: Covers silicon and compound wafers, electronic gases, wet chemicals, photoresists, CMP materials, sputtering targets, and cleanroom consumables.
exclusions: Process equipment and fab automation remain owned by semiconductor_manufacturing_equipment.
aliases: 半导体材料与电子化学品

chains.chain_name: Semiconductor Packaging, Test, and Advanced Packaging
chains.description: Back-end semiconductor chain for assembly, testing, reliability screening, and advanced package integration of semiconductor devices.
chains.scope: Covers IC packaging, wafer-level packaging, chiplets, 2.5D and 3D integration, burn-in, test services, and reliability qualification.
exclusions: Front-end wafer processing equipment remains owned by semiconductor_manufacturing_equipment.
aliases: 半导体封装测试与先进封装

chains.description: Canonical industry chain for electrical interconnect products and passive components that route, join, filter, and condition power or signals.
chains.scope: Covers power cables, busbars and busways, high-current and HVDC connectors, flexible copper links, magnetic components, capacitors, and related manufacturing processes.
exclusions: Active power semiconductor devices remain owned by power_semiconductors.
Complete power-conversion and distribution equipment remains owned by power_electronics_power_supply_equipment.
aliases: 印制电路板被动元件与连接互连

chains.description: Canonical commercial optoelectronics chain for mass-production display panels and qualified light-emitting, imaging, and optical components used in electronic products.
chains.scope: Covers commercial and mass-production LCD, OLED, qualified MicroLED, display modules, backplanes, LEDs, laser components, and optical sensing or illumination components.
exclusions: Medical imaging systems remain owned by medical_imaging_diagnostic_equipment, not component-level optoelectronics.

Pre-commercial display concepts and emerging technical routes remain owned by future_displays until they reach repeatable commercial mass-production; mature commercialization and manufacturing belong here.

chains.chain_name: AI Foundation Models and Application Software
chains.description: Software stack for foundation models, model tooling, and applications that deliver generative and intelligent capabilities to users and enterprises.
chains.scope: Covers large language, multimodal, vision, and agent models; training frameworks; inference platforms; and vertical AI applications.
exclusions: AI accelerators remain owned by ai_logic_compute_chips and data-center facilities by cloud_data_center_infrastructure.

chains.description: Compute-platform chain for servers, clusters, storage, orchestration, and systems software used to train and serve AI workloads.
chains.scope: Covers AI servers, accelerator clusters, distributed storage, scheduling platforms, virtualization, and cluster management software.
exclusions: Facility power-conversion and distribution equipment remain owned by power_electronics_power_supply_equipment, while facility construction and cooling systems remain owned by cloud_data_center_infrastructure.

chains.description: Canonical infrastructure chain for data-center facilities, thermal systems, integrated delivery, commissioning, and operations.
chains.scope: Covers modular data-center systems, liquid-cooling equipment and loops, facility integration, DCIM platforms, electrical design, EPC, commissioning, certification, and facility operations.
exclusions: Generic utility generation, grid equipment, and power-conversion products remain owned by their primary energy chains.
Compute chips, servers, storage, and network equipment remain owned by their respective information-technology and semiconductor chains.
aliases: 云与数据中心基础设施

chains.description: Network-infrastructure chain for mobile radio access, core networks, spectrum use, and 5G or 6G service delivery.
chains.scope: Covers base stations, radio units, antennas, mobile core platforms, transport interfaces, private networks, and 5G-Advanced or 6G evolution.
exclusions: Fixed optical transport remains owned by optical_communications_data_center_interconnect.

chains.chain_name: Optical Communications and Data Center Interconnect
chains.description: Optical-network chain for high-speed transmission links and interconnect systems joining telecom networks, cloud sites, and AI clusters.
chains.scope: Covers optical fiber, modules, coherent transmission, WDM equipment, switches for optical fabrics, and data-center interconnect deployment.
exclusions: Radio access networks remain owned by mobile_communications_5g_6g and general facility construction by cloud_data_center_infrastructure.
aliases: 光通信与数据中心互连

chains.description: Connectivity chain for enterprise networking, edge platforms, and Internet of Things devices that collect, route, and process distributed data.
chains.scope: Covers routers, switches, gateways, edge servers, IoT modules, industrial gateways, and device connectivity management.
exclusions: Mobile carrier radio infrastructure remains owned by mobile_communications_5g_6g.
aliases: 网络设备、边缘计算与物联网

chains.chain_name: Foundational Software, Operating Systems, and Databases
chains.description: Core software chain for operating systems, database engines, middleware, runtime environments, and developer platforms underpinning digital systems.
chains.scope: Covers desktop, server, and embedded operating systems; relational and distributed databases; middleware; and foundational development toolchains.
exclusions: Industrial-domain applications remain owned by industrial_software and security products by cybersecurity_data_infrastructure.
aliases: 基础软件、操作系统与数据库

chains.description: Canonical industry chain for operational, engineering, monitoring, optimization, and predictive software used in industrial and infrastructure systems.
chains.scope: Covers electrical and facility monitoring platforms, building management software, thermal control, fault prediction, compute-energy scheduling, and carbon, energy, and cost optimization software.
exclusions: Physical power, grid, cooling, and data-center facility equipment remains owned by the corresponding equipment or infrastructure chain.
Generic operating systems, databases, and cybersecurity platforms remain owned by their primary foundational-software chains.

chains.description: Digital-trust chain for cybersecurity products, data governance, identity systems, and resilient infrastructure protecting information assets.
chains.scope: Covers endpoint, network, cloud, and application security; identity access management; data protection; backup; governance; and security operations.
exclusions: Underlying operating systems and database engines remain owned by foundational_software_os_database.
aliases: 网络安全与数据基础设施

chains.description: Equipment-system chain for CNC machine tools and machining centers that shape, cut, form, and finish industrial components.
chains.scope: Covers CNC controls, lathes, milling centers, grinding machines, machining centers, tooling interfaces, and metalworking automation.
exclusions: Laser processing equipment remains owned by laser_equipment_additive_manufacturing.

chains.description: Control-system chain for industrial automation hardware and software that coordinate machines, production lines, and process operations.
chains.scope: Covers PLCs, DCS, motion controllers, servo drives, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks, and automation engineering services.
exclusions: Industrial operations applications remain owned by industrial_software.

chains.description: Robot-system chain for programmable industrial manipulators and integrated workcells used in manufacturing, logistics, and hazardous operations.
chains.scope: Covers articulated, SCARA, collaborative, mobile industrial robots, robot controllers, end effectors, and system integration.
exclusions: Humanoid products and embodied intelligence remain owned by humanoid_robots_embodied_intelligence.

chains.description: A primarily system-architecture decomposition of humanoid robots spanning embodied intelligence, control, sensing, compute, actuation, body, and energy subsystems, with one explicit supplementary lifecycle and value-chain family.
chains.scope: Covers robot-specific models and software, integrated sensing and control modules, reusable electromechanical components, complete humanoid robots, and their manufacturing, test, operations, and scenario integration. Under the approved mixed-template rule, humanoid_manufacturing_test_integration supplements the primary system architecture with lifecycle coverage.
exclusions: General-purpose AI foundation models remain owned by their primary AI chain; this chain covers robot-adapted embodied models and inference.
General semiconductor chips remain owned by semiconductor chains; this chain covers robot-selected compute components and integrated modules.

Generic battery cells, battery management systems, and battery materials remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials; this chain covers humanoid-specific selection, integration, and control requirements.
General industrial robots, machine tools, and factory automation remain owned by their primary equipment chains unless humanoid-specific.
aliases: 人形机器人与具身智能

chains.description: Manufacturing-equipment chain for industrial lasers and additive processes that cut, weld, mark, deposit, and build complex parts.
chains.scope: Covers laser sources, processing heads, laser machining systems, metal additive manufacturing, and related process materials or services.
exclusions: Conventional CNC machining centers remain owned by industrial_machine_tools_cnc.

chains.description: Instrument-system chain for laboratory, analytical, measurement, and research equipment used to observe, characterize, and quantify materials or processes.
chains.scope: Covers analytical instruments, laboratory instruments, precision measurement devices, spectrometers, chromatographs, and research-grade platforms.
exclusions: Production-line vision and metrology equipment remain owned by industrial_inspection_metrology_machine_vision.

chains.chain_name: Industrial Inspection, Metrology, and Machine Vision
chains.description: Quality-system chain for industrial inspection, precision metrology, and machine vision products that measure and detect manufacturing defects.
chains.scope: Covers visual inspection, coordinate measurement, non-destructive testing, dimensional metrology, process inspection, and machine-vision software.
exclusions: Standalone scientific research instruments remain owned by scientific_instruments.
aliases: 工业检测、计量与机器视觉

chains.description: Component-system chain for high-performance mechanical elements that transmit motion, force, fluid power, and structural load in equipment.
chains.scope: Covers bearings, gears, reducers, screws, linear guides, hydraulic and pneumatic components, seals, and precision transmission assemblies.
exclusions: Complete robots and machine tools remain owned by industrial_robots and industrial_machine_tools_cnc.

chains.description: Specialized-equipment chain for process industries that transform chemicals, materials, food, pharmaceuticals, and energy products at scale.
chains.scope: Covers reactors, separation equipment, process skids, industrial furnaces, mixing systems, and packaged process production lines.
exclusions: Biologic drug production processes remain owned by biologic_antibody_drugs and synthetic_biology_biomanufacturing.

chains.chain_name: New Power System and Smart Grid
chains.description: Canonical infrastructure chain for connecting, transforming, switching, protecting, monitoring, and maintaining power flows across modern grids.
chains.scope: Covers grid-connection engineering, substations, transformers, switchgear, relay protection, power-quality systems, DC breakers, and DC protection systems.
exclusions: Power generation equipment and energy procurement services remain owned by power_generation_energy_equipment.
Data-center internal UPS, rectification, rack distribution, and server power equipment remain owned by power_electronics_power_supply_equipment.
aliases: 新型电力系统与智能电网

chains.description: Canonical industry chain for generation systems, power-supply services, distributed energy, microgrids, and generation-based resilience.
chains.scope: Covers grid and nuclear supply services, renewable procurement services, distributed generation, gas turbines, microgrids, diesel and gas backup generation, and black-start generation services.
exclusions: Grid connection, substations, transformation, and protection remain owned by new_power_system_smart_grid.
Fuel-cell and stationary energy-storage technologies remain owned by hydrogen_fuel_cells and new_energy_storage respectively.

chains.chain_name: Power Electronics and Power Supply Equipment
chains.description: Canonical industry chain for power conversion, transfer, distribution, regulation, and control equipment from facility input through server-board delivery.
chains.scope: Covers UPS equipment, transfer switches, rectifiers and inverters, HVDC systems, DC buses, power distribution units, power shelves, server power supplies, AC-DC and DC-DC modules, voltage regulators, and power controllers.
exclusions: Power semiconductor devices and passive interconnect components remain owned by their respective semiconductor and interconnect chains.
Utility-grid substations, transformers, switchgear, and grid protection remain owned by new_power_system_smart_grid.

chains.description: Application-chain view of the electrical, thermal, software, engineering, and operational dependencies required to power high-density AI data centers.
chains.scope: Covers capacity planning, resilient energy supply, grid access, backup power, UPS and DC conversion, room and rack distribution, server-board power, liquid cooling, energy-management software, and facility delivery and operations for AI data centers.
exclusions: Canonical grid equipment, power-conversion and distribution products, and data-center facilities remain owned by new_power_system_smart_grid, power_electronics_power_supply_equipment, and cloud_data_center_infrastructure respectively; company and evidence ownership stays on referenced canonical nodes.
Compute accelerators, servers, networking, storage, and AI software workloads are outside this power-application chain except where they define power or cooling requirements.
aliases: AI Compute Power and Cooling Chain
AI数据中心电力基础设施

chains.description: Photovoltaic industry chain for solar cells, modules, manufacturing materials, and generation equipment that convert sunlight into electricity.
chains.scope: Covers polysilicon, wafers, cells, modules, inverters specific to PV systems, mounting structures, and photovoltaic manufacturing processes.
exclusions: Grid connection and substation infrastructure remain owned by new_power_system_smart_grid.

chains.description: Wind-energy chain for turbines, blades, drivetrains, offshore foundations, and manufacturing systems that harvest kinetic energy from wind.
chains.scope: Covers onshore and offshore wind turbines, blades, nacelles, towers, gearboxes, generators, foundations, and wind-farm equipment supply.
exclusions: Marine vessels and offshore drilling equipment remain owned by ships_offshore_deep_sea_equipment.

chains.description: Primary canonical ownership skeleton for power-battery cells, battery management platforms, pack and system integration, and battery materials across the manufacturing value chain.
chains.scope: This skeleton establishes canonical ownership for generic high-specific-energy power-battery cells and battery management system platforms. Later expansion may add cell manufacturing, pack integration, recycling, and battery-material process families without changing application-chain ownership.
exclusions: Humanoid-specific cell selection, BMS integration, robot battery packs, and robot power controls remain owned by humanoid_robots_embodied_intelligence.
Stationary energy-storage systems and grid integration remain owned by their primary energy-storage and power-system chains.
Vehicle-specific battery installation and vehicle energy management remain owned by intelligent-vehicle chains; generic battery products remain canonical here.

chains.description: Canonical technology-route chain for stationary energy-storage systems that provide resilient electrical power through battery, flywheel, and UPS storage technologies.
chains.scope: Covers stationary battery backup systems, flywheel backup energy systems, UPS battery systems, and their application-neutral energy-storage technology routes and system ownership.
exclusions: Generic high-specific-energy power-battery cells and battery management system platforms remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials.
Application-specific backup-power sizing, redundancy, facility integration, procurement, and operating policy remain owned by the relevant application chain.
Backup generators, automatic transfer switches, fuel-cell systems, and black-start controls remain owned by their primary generation, power-conversion, and hydrogen chains.

chains.description: Canonical technology-route chain for hydrogen conversion and fuel-cell systems used in stationary, mobile, and industrial energy applications.
chains.scope: Covers stationary fuel-cell backup systems and their fuel-cell technology route, balance-of-plant integration, and application-neutral product ownership.
exclusions: Hydrogen production, transport, and storage infrastructure outside the fuel-cell system boundary remains owned by dedicated hydrogen supply chains when introduced.
Application-specific backup-power sizing, redundancy, and facility integration remain owned by the relevant application chain.

chains.description: Nuclear-system chain for reactor islands, conventional islands, safety systems, fuel handling, and specialized equipment supporting fission generation.
chains.scope: Covers reactor vessels, steam generators, control systems, nuclear pumps and valves, fuel handling, radiation monitoring, and plant equipment.
exclusions: Experimental fusion routes remain owned by controlled_nuclear_fusion.

chains.description: Materials chain for high-performance metals and alloys engineered for strength, temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, and precision applications.
chains.scope: Covers titanium, nickel-based, high-strength steel, aluminum, magnesium, and other specialty alloy production and processing routes.
exclusions: Rare-earth magnets and critical mineral processing remain owned by rare_earth_permanent_magnets_critical_minerals.

chains.chain_name: Rare Earth Permanent Magnets and Critical Minerals
chains.description: Critical-materials chain for rare-earth extraction, separation, permanent magnets, and strategic mineral inputs required by advanced industries.
chains.scope: Covers rare-earth mining, separation, metal refining, NdFeB magnets, dysprosium materials, and related critical mineral processing.
exclusions: Battery cathode and anode materials remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials.

chains.description: Composite-materials chain for carbon fiber, resin matrices, prepregs, and engineered structures that reduce weight while maintaining performance.
chains.scope: Covers carbon fiber precursor, carbon fiber, prepreg, resin systems, fiber-reinforced composites, and composite forming processes.
exclusions: Aircraft and spacecraft structural integration remain owned by civil_aircraft_aero_engines and commercial_space_launch.
aliases: 碳纤维与先进复合材料

chains.description: Inorganic-materials chain for engineered ceramics and specialty glass with optical, thermal, dielectric, structural, or protective performance.
chains.scope: Covers technical ceramics, electronic ceramics, optical glass, cover glass, glass substrates, refractory materials, and precision forming processes.
exclusions: Display panel fabrication remains owned by display_panels_optoelectronic_components.

chains.description: Polymer-materials chain for engineering plastics and high-performance resins designed for heat, chemical, electrical, and mechanical durability.
chains.scope: Covers fluoropolymers, polyimides, PEEK, PPS, engineering resins, modified plastics, compounding, and polymer processing materials.
exclusions: Biodegradable materials made through biological synthesis remain owned by synthetic_biology_biomanufacturing.
aliases: 高性能聚合物与工程塑料

chains.description: Functional-materials chain for membranes and separation media that selectively filter, purify, concentrate, or recover gases and liquids.
chains.scope: Covers industrial and environmental reverse-osmosis, ultrafiltration, ion-exchange, gas-separation, and catalytic membrane materials and their manufacturing processes.
exclusions: Complete municipal and industrial water-treatment systems remain owned by water_treatment_resource_technology.
Battery separators remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials; this chain is limited to industrial and environmental separation membranes.

chains.description: Functional-materials chain for nanoscale and engineered materials that provide targeted electrical, magnetic, catalytic, optical, or protective properties.
chains.scope: Covers nanocarbon, nanopowders, functional coatings, electronic pastes, catalytic nanomaterials, and advanced material surface treatment routes.
exclusions: Dedicated semiconductor process materials remain owned by semiconductor_materials_electronic_chemicals.

chains.chain_name: New Energy Vehicle Architecture and Platforms
chains.description: Vehicle-platform chain for electric and hybrid vehicle architectures that integrate body, battery, electric drive, controls, and safety systems.
chains.scope: Covers dedicated EV platforms, vehicle electrical architectures, body integration, platform engineering, homologation interfaces, and complete vehicle system design.
exclusions: Generic traction batteries remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials and charging grids by new_power_system_smart_grid.

chains.description: Vehicle-intelligence chain for automated driving, cockpit interaction, perception, decision, control, and in-car user-experience systems.
chains.scope: Covers ADAS, autonomous-driving software, vehicle perception, domain controllers, cockpit OS, displays, voice interaction, and occupant experience systems.
exclusions: Roadside networking equipment remains owned by network_equipment_edge_iot, while cloud facilities remain owned by cloud_data_center_infrastructure; this chain covers vehicle-side intelligence.

chains.description: Automotive-electronics chain for vehicle control, sensing, connectivity, and chip integration that meets transport-grade reliability requirements.
chains.scope: Covers ECUs, automotive SoCs, power modules, radar and camera electronics, in-vehicle networks, and qualified chip application integration.
exclusions: Generic semiconductor design and wafer manufacturing remain owned by their semiconductor chains.
aliases: 汽车电子与车规芯片应用

chains.chain_name: Electric Drive, Chassis-by-Wire, and Thermal Management
chains.description: Vehicle-motion chain for electric propulsion, steer-by-wire and brake-by-wire systems, chassis control, and integrated thermal management.
chains.scope: Covers motors, inverters, transmissions, e-axles, wire-control actuators, suspension control, heat pumps, and vehicle thermal loops.
exclusions: Cell chemistry and battery management platforms remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials.
aliases: 电驱、线控底盘与热管理

chains.description: Rail-system chain for rolling stock, traction, signaling, control, and maintenance equipment that delivers passenger and freight rail services.
chains.scope: Covers locomotives, EMUs, metro vehicles, traction systems, signaling, braking, rail control, depot equipment, and maintenance systems.
exclusions: Roadside network equipment remains owned by network_equipment_edge_iot; road-vehicle coordination applications are outside the rail-equipment boundary.

chains.description: Application chain for cross-chain orchestration, service delivery, and data flow across vehicles, roadside systems, cloud platforms, and transport operations.
chains.scope: Covers cross-chain service and data flow for V2X coordination, traffic-control applications, vehicle-cloud orchestration, digital-road services, fleet dispatch, and mobility operations.
exclusions: Vehicle hardware and subsystems remain owned by new_energy_vehicle_architecture_platforms, intelligent_driving_smart_cockpit, automotive_electronics_chip_applications, and electric_drive_chassis_by_wire_thermal_management.
Roadside and network hardware remain owned by network_equipment_edge_iot.
Cloud and data-center infrastructure remain owned by cloud_data_center_infrastructure.

chains.description: Aviation-system chain for civil aircraft, aero engines, flight controls, avionics, and the engineering or support systems required for airworthiness.
chains.scope: Covers airframes, turbofan engines, avionics, flight-control systems, landing gear, cabin systems, test equipment, and maintenance support.
exclusions: Low-altitude drones and eVTOL platforms remain owned by uav_evtol_low_altitude_economy.
aliases: 民用航空器与航空发动机

chains.description: Space-access chain for launch vehicles, rocket propulsion, launch sites, recovery systems, and commercial services that place payloads in orbit.
chains.scope: Covers launchers, liquid and solid rocket engines, stages, avionics, ground support, launch operations, recovery, and launch-service integration.
exclusions: Satellite manufacturing and orbital infrastructure remain owned by satellite_manufacturing_space_infrastructure.

chains.description: Orbital-infrastructure chain for satellite platforms, payloads, constellation hardware, ground systems, and in-space service engineering.
chains.scope: Covers satellite buses, payload integration, power and thermal subsystems, ground stations, constellation deployment, and space infrastructure operations.
exclusions: Ground network equipment remains owned by network_equipment_edge_iot and optical_communications_data_center_interconnect; downstream communications, navigation, and remote-sensing applications are outside this manufacturing boundary.

chains.chain_name: Satellite Communications, Navigation, and Remote Sensing
chains.description: Application chain for cross-chain orchestration, service delivery, and data flow across satellite communications, positioning, navigation, timing, and remote sensing.
chains.scope: Covers cross-chain service and data flow for satellite broadband, GNSS applications, earth-observation delivery, navigation services, and remote-sensing information products.
exclusions: Satellite platforms and ground-terminal hardware remain owned by satellite_manufacturing_space_infrastructure.
Terrestrial network infrastructure remains owned by network_equipment_edge_iot and optical_communications_data_center_interconnect.

chains.description: Low-altitude aviation chain for unmanned aircraft, eVTOL vehicles, flight systems, airspace services, and commercial operating scenarios.
chains.scope: Covers drones, eVTOL aircraft, propulsion and control systems, ground stations, low-altitude operations, airworthiness, and service integration.
exclusions: Conventional civil airliners and turbofan engines remain owned by civil_aircraft_aero_engines.

chains.description: Marine-equipment chain for shipbuilding, offshore engineering, subsea systems, and deep-sea exploration or production equipment.
chains.scope: Covers commercial vessels, offshore platforms, subsea production systems, marine power systems, deep-sea vehicles, and ocean engineering equipment.
exclusions: Wind turbine manufacturing remains owned by wind_power even when deployed offshore.

chains.description: Specialized-system chain for mission electronics, sensing, communications, control, and purpose-built equipment used in defense and security applications.
chains.scope: Covers radar, electronic warfare, secure communications, command systems, optoelectronics, mission computers, and specialized support equipment.
exclusions: Commercial telecom networks remain owned by mobile_communications_5g_6g and network_equipment_edge_iot.

chains.description: Pharmaceutical chain for discovery, development, production, and delivery of innovative chemically synthesized small-molecule medicines.
chains.scope: Covers target discovery, medicinal chemistry, preclinical development, clinical supply, API synthesis, formulation, and innovative drug manufacturing.
exclusions: Biologics and antibody therapies remain owned by biologic_antibody_drugs.

chains.description: Biopharmaceutical chain for antibody, protein, and other biologic medicines requiring cell culture, purification, and controlled biologic manufacturing.
chains.scope: Covers monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, biosimilars, cell-line development, upstream culture, downstream purification, and biologics fill-finish.
exclusions: Cell and gene therapies remain owned by cell_gene_therapy, while prophylactic vaccines remain owned by vaccines.

chains.description: Preventive-biologics chain for vaccine research, antigen production, formulation, fill-finish, cold-chain quality, and immunization product delivery.
chains.scope: Covers prophylactic vaccines, antigen and adjuvant preparation, vaccine manufacturing, quality control, packaging, and cold-chain product management.
exclusions: Therapeutic antibodies and proteins remain owned by biologic_antibody_drugs.

chains.description: Advanced-therapy chain for engineered cells, gene delivery, genome editing, viral vectors, and patient-specific therapeutic manufacturing.

exclusions: General biologic antibodies remain owned by biologic_antibody_drugs.

chains.description: Biomanufacturing chain for enabling production platforms, engineered organisms, and biological processes that make non-pharmaceutical chemicals, materials, food, and industrial products.
chains.scope: Covers enabling production platforms for strain engineering, DNA synthesis, fermentation, bioreactors, downstream processing, industrial enzymes, and non-pharmaceutical bio-based manufacturing.
exclusions: Clinical cell and gene therapies remain owned by cell_gene_therapy.
Therapeutic drug products remain owned by biologic_antibody_drugs and small_molecule_innovative_drugs; this chain owns enabling platforms rather than pharmaceutical products.

chains.description: Medical-device chain for advanced diagnostic, therapeutic, surgical, implantable, monitoring, and life-support systems used in clinical care.
chains.scope: Covers surgical robots, implants, interventional systems, anesthesia and life-support equipment, patient monitoring, and high-end therapeutic devices.
exclusions: Imaging systems remain owned by medical_imaging_diagnostic_equipment and laboratory assays by in_vitro_diagnostics.

chains.description: Clinical-imaging chain for equipment and software that acquire, reconstruct, display, and interpret anatomical or functional diagnostic information.
chains.scope: Covers CT, MRI, ultrasound, X-ray, nuclear imaging, endoscopic imaging, imaging workstations, and diagnostic equipment integration.
exclusions: In-vitro reagent and analyzer products remain owned by in_vitro_diagnostics.

chains.description: Diagnostics-manufacturing chain for reagents, analyzers, test consumables, and laboratory workflows that detect conditions from biological samples.

exclusions: Imaging-based diagnosis remains owned by medical_imaging_diagnostic_equipment.

chains.description: Healthcare-software chain for digital records, care platforms, clinical decision tools, telehealth, and data systems that organize health services.
chains.scope: Covers hospital information systems, electronic health records, telemedicine, health-data platforms, clinical AI software, and care-management applications.
exclusions: Physical diagnostic devices remain owned by high_end_medical_devices and medical_imaging_diagnostic_equipment.

chains.description: Agribiotechnology chain for breeding, seed production, genetic tools, biological inputs, and modern seed systems that improve agricultural productivity.
chains.scope: Covers molecular breeding, seed selection, seed multiplication, agricultural genomics, bio-pesticides, bio-fertilizers, and seed quality systems.
exclusions: Industrial fermentation products remain owned by synthetic_biology_biomanufacturing.

chains.chain_name: Air, Soil, and Industrial Pollution Control
chains.description: Environmental-control chain for equipment and services that prevent, capture, treat, monitor, and remediate air, soil, and industrial pollutants.
chains.scope: Covers flue-gas treatment, VOC control, dust removal, contaminated-site remediation, industrial emissions monitoring, and pollution-control engineering.
